title: Min-base floor for WoW%-growth backlog-trend triggers (PROP-030 threshold amendment)
created_by: tinker run 2026-07-12T02-40 (commitment from reports 2026-07-10/11: 'will propose a min-base floor if it fires a 4th time' — it fired a 4th time)
problem: PROP-030's WoW-percentage-growth triggers (info >5%, moderate >10%, major >20%) fire mechanically on tiny bases where percentage is meaningless. Four consecutive reports (2026-07-10T02-40, 2026-07-11T02-40, 2026-07-11T11-37, 2026-07-12T02-40) emitted major backlog-trend findings on bases of 3-14 open issues (e.g. 6 -> 10 = +67% WoW) while every absolute-health signal was green (net_velocity +29/7d, 0 unrouted). Recurrent false-positive majors erode finding credibility.
proposal: Amend tinker.md PROP-030 threshold table: WoW%-growth clauses (grew >5%/>10%/>20% WoW) only fire when BOTH the comparison-base row and the current row have open_issues_total >= 30. All absolute-threshold clauses (>200, >300, >400, assigned-analyst counts, net-velocity streaks, age buckets) are unchanged and continue to protect the small-base regime. One sentence added to the threshold table's preamble; no script change (thresholds are prompt-evaluated).
alternatives_considered: Absolute-delta floor (e.g. fire only if delta >= 10 issues) — rejected as a second knob to calibrate; base floor is simpler and the absolute tiers already cover large-delta cases. Suppressing WoW findings entirely during quiet-period — rejected, cadence-coupled logic is fragile.
verification_grade_note: Pattern checks the amendment text landed in the prompt.
risk: negligible — a real backlog explosion from a small base crosses an absolute tier (>200) or the negative-velocity streak long before WoW% would have added signal
